thread:
deploybot: deploycheck FAILED for service=inference-worker image=redwood/inference:v2.3.1 -> prod. Reason: chart schema validation error: field 'batching.max_items' expected integer but found string ("128").

maria: hmm, that's odd — staging has it as an int. did a values override sneak in?

riley: yep, PR #4823 changed a helm override. snippet from the PR: `batching.max_items: "128"` (looks like someone templated a string).

jt: deploy window still open for ~2h. do we want to force the rollout or hold? this seems like a parsing issue that will crash the worker at startup.

ahmed: crashing in prod is bad. we should hold. simple options: revert the values change, coerce in the chart (toInt), or patch the runtime to accept strings. revert is fastest.

maria: agreed — hold rollout. @riley can you open a revert? also add a quick CI check for schema types.

riley: on it. opening revert PR now and will follow up with a chart coercion PR.

riley: PR #4890 opened: revert helm values override from #4823. ETA 10m to merge + run deploycheck.

jt: I'll update the release notes draft to mark the release as HELD due to env parity config type mismatch. also pinging customer-facing comms in case canary was in a customer segment.

maria: good. @ahmed can you run a targeted staging smoke after revert merges? want to confirm staging/prod parity.

ahmed: will run smoke and a quick lint against helm schema. also will run an automated parse test: `python -c 'import yaml,sys; import json; json.dumps(yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin.read()))'` on the rendered values.yaml to catch type diffs.

riley: merge done. deploybot: running deploycheck.

deploybot: deploycheck still failing for candidate: found legacy override in infra repo at `infra/k8s/templates/common-values.yaml` that rewrites batching as string.

riley: ugh — infra has a generated file. will patch generator to emit ints. new PR #4892 to fix infra template.

maria: ok plan: 1) keep rollout paused, 2) merge infra patch, 3) rerun deploycheck, 4) run canary in 20m after green.

jt: bumping release window message: "Release paused — investigation in progress (config type mismatch)"

ahmed: infra patch merged, rendering tests pass locally. launching a staging canary now.

deploybot: deploycheck PASSED for candidate after infra patch. status: ready -> awaiting human unpause.

maria: re-run canary in 20. @riley put a short note in the release notes: "Hold due to config type mismatch; reverted faulty override; infra generator patched to enforce integer types."

riley: done. release notes updated and squash commit pushed.

jt: notifying SRE rotation and product for visibility.

maria: thanks everyone. follow-up actions: add helm/value schema lint in PR CI, add a deploycheck rule for type mismatches, and run a sweep for other numeric fields that might be templated as strings. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

ahmed: copied action items into the post-release checklist ticket.

riley: canary green. unpausing release.

maria: marking thread resolved once release completes. keep any postmortem notes here if needed.
